content.value_statement: Many decks and reports lose impact because styling is inconsistent or slow to create. This skill applies curated palettes and font pairings so artifacts look polished and coherent.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled PDF showcase of ten preset visual themes.
Provides named color palettes with exact hex values for each theme.
Recommends header and body fonts for consistent typography.
Guides theme application across slides, reports, documents, and HTML artifacts.
Supports creation of a custom theme when preset options do not fit.
Lists suitable contexts for each preset theme.
limitations: Does not include scripts that automatically rewrite source files.
Requires the assistant to inspect and modify the target artifact separately.
Bundled font names may not exist in every execution environment.
Theme choices still need user review for brand compliance.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Client Presentation
use_cases.description: Apply a polished palette and font pairing to a consulting deck before delivery.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Reports
use_cases.description: Use one visual theme across recurring reports so charts, headings, and sections feel consistent.

use_cases.title: Create a Campaign Look
use_cases.description: Generate a custom theme from campaign goals when the preset themes do not match the desired style.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for browsing available themes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase and help me choose one theme for this presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Selected Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows which preset theme to use.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to my slide deck. Keep the layout, but update colors and typography.

prompt_templates.title: Match Theme to Audience
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a recommendation based on context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best theme for an executive sustainability report, then apply it consistently across the artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a new visual identity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a security product launch. Include colors, fonts, best uses, and apply it after my approval.

output_examples.input: Apply a calm professional theme to a financial report.
output: Primary styling uses deep navy, teal accents, seafoam highlights, and cream backgrounds.
Headers use DejaVu Sans Bold, and body text uses DejaVu Sans.

output_examples.input: Create a new theme for a wellness workshop deck.
output: The palette uses soft green, warm white, muted clay, and charcoal for readable contrast.
The theme should be reviewed before it is applied to the deck.

output_examples.input: Make this technology launch page feel more modern.
output: Use electric blue for primary actions, neon cyan for highlights, dark gray for backgrounds, and white for text.
Keep spacing and hierarchy stable while updating the visual system.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a theme for important work.
Check text contrast after applying each color palette.
Get user approval before applying a generated custom theme.
anti_patterns: Do not mix several preset themes in one artifact without a clear reason.
Do not override brand requirements without explicit approval.
Do not apply decorative colors where they reduce readability.

faq.question: What kinds of artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes with color palettes and font pairings.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft a custom theme from your goals and ask for review before applying it.

faq.question: Does it automatically edit files?
faq.answer: No. It provides theme guidance, and the assistant must modify the target artifact separately.

faq.question: Does it include exact color values?
faq.answer: Yes. Each theme file lists named colors with hex values.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
